facts.fact: The Digital Cooperation Organization reports that the Gambian government has adopted policies and a master plan with data localisation provisions, naming the National Digital Economy Master Plan 2024-2034 (and, separately, a 2023-2033 version) among them; its data were current as of September 2024.

The Digital Cooperation Organization lists the National Digital Economy Master Plan 2024-2034, issued by the Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy, among the guidelines it consulted, with a stated period of 2024 to 2034 and a source link not marked as broken; its data were current as of September 2024.

The Digital Cooperation Organization reports that the UN Economic Commission for Africa held a validation workshop with the Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy to present the Digital ID and Digital Transformation Strategy for 2023-2028, without giving a date or an adopting act; dated here to the report's October 2025 publication.

facts.fact: The Digital Cooperation Organization marks its source for the Digital Transformation Strategy for The Gambia 2023-2028 as not working in four of its source lists, so it records no accessible public text; dated to the report's October 2025 publication.
